blocks.text: The Bureau of Immigration (BI) began deporting 115 Chinese nationals arrested in raids the previous month on suspected illegal offshore gaming hubs in Quezon City and Zamboanga Sibugay province. The suspects—62 Chinese arrested in Zamboanga Sibugay on Oct. 2 and 53 others apprehended in Cubao, Quezon City, on Oct. 12—will be flown back to China
